plan.title: Award both lines to Vendor B without approval flow

steps.note: Open the existing closed two-bid RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the prepared event.
Confirm both bidding vendors are represented by real names before awarding.
Verify the available prepared line shows Vendor B's stated rate.
Allocate the available line to Vendor B, create the proposal, and submit it in the catalog's combined award flow.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the post-award flow and create the purchase order for the awarded vendor.
Verify the available awarded line appears in the resulting purchase order with its requested quantity.
Open the History tab where a completed award should be listed.
Assert that this plan's awarded event appears in History.
